data.content_ref: inline:SRC_001 conflates implementation diversity with true independence, yet the problem asks for evidence that distinguishes genuine independence from merely-uncorrelated-until-shared-cause failures. By conditioning its pro-decentralization claim on 'provided the failures are truly independent' without any evidentiary mechanism for establishing that condition, it presupposes exactly what the problem requires be identified. Its two counterconditions only surface shared-library/protocol bugs, but the problem's deeper challenge is that decentralized nodes may share latent environmental triggers (cloud-provider outage, TLS library, time-source) that look uncorrelated until the shared cause appears; SRC_001 gives no test for that. The mechanism's appeal to 'variety of implementations' is precisely the kind of surface diversity the problem warns may be illusory.
